in_hindi.name: जसकरण
in_hindi.long_meaning: ज्योतिर्मय करण (जस: born of, करण: form, ज्योतिर्मय: born of light)

in_marathi.name: Jaskaran
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Creator of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaskaran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaskaran is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Jas’ meaning creator and ‘Kar’ meaning action. It signifies the one who creates the universe through his actions.

in_bengali.name: Jaskaran
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Creator of the Universe
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jaskaran একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Jaskaran is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Jas’ meaning creator and ‘Kar’ meaning action. It signifies the one who creates the universe through his actions.
